ball_sourced.evidence: exports/turret/launch/ball.json: sources with URLs and the date checked; the unknowns swept with a bench plan

launch_cap_70fps.how: the regulated 12 V rail + the Snail's 875 rpm/V + the Ø36 tyre: 10.4 krpm no-load = 19.7 m/s surface, so even 100 % throttle on a fast motor and a high rail cannot reach 70 fps; the ESC set speed (9.4 krpm, 55 fps nominal) sits under that, and the chronograph latches SAFE on any over-cap shot

feed_no_jam_all_poses.note: misses are empty steps (the hopper not delivering): bridging, which rigid spheres under-predict; the bench counts them
